disclosure_adapter_stemmer.why_it_is_the_adapters_correctness_not_t: INTERFACES section 2 has named the analyzer's stemmer as Snowball's Porter since its first version, before S7 existed: 'stopwords, Porter stemmer via `snowballstemmer`' (docs/INTERFACES.md line 117 at 4a17dc7, 2026-11-09 23:25:45 UTC). The referee's own analyzer followed it from the start (referee/porter.py, 9e2a700, 2026-11-09: 'It follows Snowball's porter definition'). The adapter's porter_stem (Lucene's PorterStemmer, which leaves one- and two-letter words alone) departed from that spec on the OpenSearch side; Lucene's snowball filter with language Porter is the specified algorithm. Nothing on the engine side or in the suite or its rules changed. The toy v2 recording, re-made with the fix, changed in 2 unsupported-family answers only, judged on the engine alone, so S3's verdicts are unaffected.
